criteria.note: Focused export tests still cover folder derivation and the export path writes notes into the chosen vault output root.
obsidianVault tests prove copyable local assets are emitted as real sourcePath file entries for image/header metadata and body markdown refs are rewritten to vault-relative paths.
GeneralSettings.vue exposes export type toggles, defaults task_obj off, and passes selectedTypeIds into buildObsidianExportFiles.
Export is disabled until at least one type is selected, and the selected set is visible in the settings panel before export starts.
content tests confirm Markdown storage stays on the Markdown envelope and legacy bodies still read best-effort through the storage adapter.
The export path uses existing app APIs and filesystem copies only; no direct SQL writes or destructive schema changes were introduced.
Relevant tests cover folder paths, asset/reference rewriting, type exclusion, and local asset URL parsing; docs-site changes were made for Eden/editor/data.

validationOutput: obsidianVault now emits real asset file-copy entries (sourcePath) for linked image objects, header image fields, inline image metadata objects, and markdown body refs.
Exported asset filenames/extensions are preserved (e.g. assets/Vacation Photo.JPG, assets/Portrait.png), and rewritten markdown points at the copied relative vault paths.
Copyable local assets no longer produce manifest-only output; the manifest remains for unresolved refs only.
platform/desktop/electron/extension-host.ts copies sourcePath entries with copyFileSync after safe source validation.
Markdown storage still flows through the Markdown envelope helper (readEntryMarkdown/writeEntryMarkdown).
residualRisks: Remote/data URL images remain unresolved and stay in the manifest.
Host-time filesystem read/copy failures are logged and skipped instead of failing the whole export.
docs-site/apps/eden.md still contains legacy text-only vault-export wording; the functional fix is in place, but the doc copy likely needs a cleanup pass.
